name: Face Stealer, Minor (Su)
body:
Benefit(s): When the slayer inflicts damage on a foe of the same type as the slayer, that drops the foe to negative hit points, as a swift action the slayer can assume the appearance of that target as if using the disguise self spell. The slayer keeps the stolen face until he takes a new face from another victim, he dismisses it (as a free action), or he runs out of duration for stolen faces for the day. The slayer can use face stealer for a maximum of 10 minutes per day per slayer level.
